description: Live Cars & Bids auctions from the site's public RSS feed (about 250 current items, newest first): auction title, auction link and id, start date, short description and photo. The feed has no current bid, reserve or end-time data, so those are not returned. Related tools on this server, for a different need: social_instagram when you need Engagement snapshot of a public Instagram account; social_olx when you need OLX classified listings search from OLX's public listing. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

limit.description: How many auctions to return, 1 to 50 (default 10)
